title: LISTEN TO THIS EVERY NIGHT Before You Sleep | Peaceful Night Affirmations By Sandeep Maheshwari
description: LISTEN TO THIS EVERY NIGHT Before You Sleep!  Sandeep Maheshwari is a name among millions who struggled, failed and surged ahead in search of success, happiness and contentment. Just like any middle class guy, he too had a bunch of unclear dreams and a blurred vision of his goals in life. All he had was an undying learning attitude to hold on to. Rowing through ups and downs, it was time that taught him the true meaning of his life.  To know more, log on to www.sandeepmaheshwari.com  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/sandeepmaheshwaripage Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sandeep__maheshwari Twitter: https://twitter.com/sandeepseminars  Background Music Purchased and Downloaded From Envato Elements at: https://elements.envato.com/yoga-relaxation-ambient-music-DFL6RNW

asr.full_text: Today was a very good day. Today I did everything with all my heart and mind. Whatever I have learned today, whatever I have understood, whatever I have experienced, I am completely satisfied with it. My body, my mind, my intellect and my soul are completely calm. Whatever happened today was better than the past. And my future tomorrow will be better than this. I am very happy and I am feeling very good. I have no worries of any kind, I have no fear. I have no bondage, I have no limit. There is no boundless. I have no limit. I am free from all kinds of bindings and completely free. This entire universe is helping me. Making me a better human being. Everyday, I learn something new. And for whatever I have learned today I am extremely thankful to my heart And for learning something new tomorrow I am fully ready My thinking is the most unique My circumstances are the most unique. My circumstances are unique. I am unique, therefore no one can compare me. I am not just this body, I am the whole Universe. The entire powers of this Universe is not outside me, they are outside me. I am free from all my evils. My mind is peaceful again, filled with bliss. and I have felt my inner voice. And I have seen even inside my head, The light of peace in my life… I believe that my I face in my life today, will become the reason for my success in the future. When I breathe, I'm full of positive thinking and with every breath I exhale my negative thoughts along with the passing of breath. Whatever happens to me, it is for the better. I find it very nice to spend time with myself is really good, by listening to the voice of my subconscious mind. that should be my aim of life. I love everyone and everyone loves me. I have no complaints from anyone. Whoever, for the sake of knowingly or unknowingly, has done something wrong me. I have forgiven those people from my very own heart. And whatever mistakes have been, in the past I completely forgive myself. My concentration is on the future and not the past. On no, but, on coming moments I have thought about my tomorrow in great detail And am so dedicated to get my every aim I would appreciate my whole heart for all that I have and everyone is really good. Everything will be Okay. I am very happy because of my loved ones. I have complete love and compassion towards you. There is only one prayer that comes to my mind that all be blessed and healthy, that everyone's intellect should walk in the right direction and that everyone's life a river of happiness in the sky. By making sure that I am not worrying about anything and so that I am not any trouble, I have been going to bed. Tomorrow morning, I will wake up with a new feeling and will make a new start in this life. Let me tell you a story today. This is just a moment of peace. And my body, my intellect, my mind are completely at peace. Shanti. Shanti. Shanti.
